title: Baltimore shopping centre rebounds as 200 community investors take ownership, with 10 new leases and 100+ jobs
summary_full: Edmondson Village Shopping Center is undergoing a significant transformation driven by local residents.  Two hundred community investors now hold a direct ownership stake in the property.  Ten new leases have been signed, bringing essential services to the neighborhood.  A planned headquarters for Meals on Wheels will create over one hundred jobs.  This community ownership model connects residents to the property's economic revival.
